rule_text: Every car must wait at least 1.5 seconds in the waiting zone before it crosses the stop line.

zones.description: waiting zone: the northbound approach lanes just before the stop line (top-down drone view; cars come from the bottom of the frame)

lines.description: stop line across the northbound approach lanes; cars travel from bottom to top of the frame
